facts.fact: President Traoré officially launched mass enrolment of the population into the Registre de l'identifiant unique électronique on 2026-11-11, and the digital transition ministry began training 1,449 volunteers (483 supervisors, 966 kit operators) on 2026-11-19 to run enrolment nationwide.
